title: Question 26
passage:
What time do the gates open for the outdoor movie?
A. Admission is free for children under twelve. B. The movie itself starts at eight thirty. C. At seven, an hour and a half before the movie starts.
passageZh:
戶外電影幾點開放入場？
A. 未滿十二歲的兒童可免費入場。
B. 電影八點半才開始。
C. 七點開放，比電影開演早一個半小時。
